title.en: Aide to the Five Majesties general

translationRepairs: Grand Minister of Agriculture Hou Ba and others said: "Wang Mang usurped Han and threw the realm into chaos.
Grand Minister over the Masses Hou Ba and others said: "Wang Mang usurped Han and threw the realm into chaos.
Chinese dasitu (大司徒) is Grand Minister over the Masses, not Grand Minister of Agriculture (dasinong).
Grand Minister of Agriculture Hou Ba and others said: "Wang Mang usurped Han and overturned the realm.
Grand Minister over the Masses Hou Ba and others said: "Wang Mang usurped Han and overturned the realm.
Same office mistranslation of 大司徒 as Agriculture.
A commoner who first lit the flame of revolt, he helped win the empire and, as father-in-law to the Princess of Ningping, stood closer to the throne than almost any other subject.
A commoner who first lit the flame of revolt, he helped win the empire and, because of the Princess of Ningping, stood closer to the throne than almost any other subject.
Chinese means because of Princess Ningping; Li Tong married her, so he is husband not father-in-law.
